_comment: Battle Frontier gate: the always-first guy, the nervous kid.
1: Oh no!\nI fell asleep and blew my chance\fto be the first one here...\rStupid, stupid me...\nSob...sob...
3:
Click, click, click...
Oh! It's you!I'm over bein' first all
the time.Now I count how many people
come to the Battle Frontier. Ain't nobody ask me to. It's just a hobby. Don't judge.
4:
I can't stop shakin'!I told my fam I'd run the
Battle Frontier when I left home...But now I'm here, and somehow I
can't stop shakin'!What I'mma do if I get
beat to a pulp?
5: ...You look real young.\r...\n...\rI'mma pull myself together and\nchallenge the Battle Frontier...\fMaybe!\r
6: I'mma pull myself together and\nchallenge the Battle Frontier!\r...\nOr I might not!\r
7: Finally!\nI'm at the Battle Frontier!\rWhen scraps on the road don't\nhit no more, you\fgotta come to the Battle Frontier!\rAin't that right?
8:
Normally, pickin' homies is all
there is to a scrap.But when you switch up the rules
or limits, the scrap suddenly get way more fun.And the spot where you get that fun...
is the Battle Frontier!
9: This the Battle Frontier\rPull Up, Proud Hustlers\nAim for the Top!
